newsitem.title: USA: Vermont Gov wants legislature to fix property tax.
newsitem.headline: Vermont Gov wants legislature to fix property tax.

text.p: Vermont Gov. Howard Dean may request live television air time to address the issue of property tax reform, according to one of his aides.
Dean has said he will call a special session of the legislature if lawmakers do not solve the crisis by the end of the current session in May 1.
The governor's plans have been derailed by the recent state Supreme Court ruling that the current system of funding schools with local property taxes is unconstitutional.

Some Vermont towns could be barred from spending more to improve their students' education. That is one possible interpretation of the Supreme Court ruling, which held that differing amounts of property value among towns denied equal educational opportunities.

Some lawmakers have interpreted that as meaning the state should provide more for towns with lower taxable property. Others, including the governor, suggested a cap on school spending to even the scales.
